Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'image/png', uri: 'https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png'), { 'ocr' => { 'backend' => 'paddleocr', 'enabled' => true, 'language' => ['en'], 'paddle_ocr_config' => { 'language' => 'en', 'model_tier' => 'mobile', 'model_version' => 'pp-ocrv6' } } })
```
